name: grid/deploy
description: Pull latest code and rebuild on grid nodes. Runs git pull + npm run build:ts on each reachable node via SSH over Tailscale. Keeps all nodes in sync without manual SSH.

params.name: nodes
params.description: Comma-separated node names or IPs to deploy to. Default: all known grid nodes.

params.name: branch
params.description: Git branch to checkout. Default: current branch on each node.

params.name: skipBuild
params.description: Skip npm run build:ts after pull (just update code). Default: false.

params.name: restart
params.description: Restart the system (npm stop + npm start) after build. Default: false.

results.name: deployedNodes
results.description: Array of { nodeId, status, branch, buildSuccess, error? } per node

examples.description: Deploy specific branch to the 5090 tower
